;Business and economy
* [[Ford Motor Company|Ford]] announces that its new electric [[SUV]] will be known as the [[Ford Mustang Mach-E|Mustang Mach-E]]. The "Mustang" model name, previously employed by Ford's muscle cars, could be an important asset for the new venture. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ford-motor-electric-mustang/ford-to-use-mustang-name-for-electric-suv-idUSKBN1XO1HT?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A vehicle collision in [[Iran]]'s southeastern [[Sistan and Baluchestan Province]] kills at least 28 people, all [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] nationals. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-50422965 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Saugus High School shooting]]
**A [[school shooting]] at [[Saugus High School (California)|Saugus High School]] in [[Santa Clarita, California]], injures [[mass shooting|five]] students, two fatally. The 16-year-old gunman, identified as Nathaniel Berhow, shoots himself, is hospitalized, and dies a day later. [https://www.cincinnati.com/story/news/2019/11/15/nathaniel-berhow-died-hospital-after-shooting-several-students-saugus/4207389002/ (''The Cincinnati Enquirer'')]
*[[2017–2018 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**After the admission of the [[European Arrest Warrant]] against her, ousted Catalan Education Minister [[Clara Ponsatí]], who is in a "self-exile" in [[Edinburgh]], appears in court and is bailed without charges hours after. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-50409771 (BBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**Chief Superintendent of Police of [[Hong Kong]] Tse Chun-chung says protesters' acts are "another step closer to [[terrorism]]". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-students-arm-themselves-for-showdown-as-police-take-breather-idUSKBN1XO06C (Reuters)]
*[[Japan–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korean government]] officials announce that [[Japan]] and the United States are interested in renewing the [[Japan–South Korea General Security of Military Information Agreement|GSOMIA]] pact between Japan and [[South Korea]] to maintain bilateral cooperation between the two nations in defense issues. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20191114003351325?section=national/diplomacy (Yonhap News Agency)]
*[[2019 Bolivian protests]], [[2019 Bolivian political crisis]]
**Bolivian police use [[tear gas]] to break up a peaceful pro-Morales counter-protest in La Paz, then block about a dozen pro-Morales senators from entering the nation's legislature. Pro-Morales demonstrators respond with cries of "[[dictatorship]]" and throw stones at the police. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/13/world/americas/bolivia-morales-news.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Politics of Moldova]]
**[[Ion Chicu]] is sworn in as [[Prime Minister of Moldova|Prime Minister]] after the collapse of [[Maia Sandu]]'s government on 12 November. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-moldova-politics-government/moldovan-parliament-approves-ion-chicu-as-new-prime-minister-idUSKBN1XO1KS (Reuters)]
